Generator source

Download the complete source for this release. It includes engine and dependency source, host JavaScript, build scripts, notices and locked package inputs.

The download verifies each part and assembles one .tar.gz archive.

Unpack the archive, run npm ci, then node scripts/planner-vendor.mjs to rebuild the procedural bundles.

For manual download, use the ordered parts and SHA-256 checksums in the source manifest. Concatenate the parts in manifest order before unpacking.
